newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-WORD CHAMPIONSHIP MEDALLIST MAZUOLIS QUITS.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-WORD CHAMPIONSHIP MEDALLIST MAZUOLIS QUITS.

text.p: World championship medallist Raimundas Mazuolis of Lithuania has quit swimming on medical advice, his coach was quoted as saying.

Mazuolis, 50 metres freestyle bronze medallist at the 1994 world championships in Rome, underwent foot surgery for bone excrescence last autumn, the German pps sports agency quoted the swimmer's German coach Michael Lohberg as saying.

But 24-year-old Mazuolis, based in Coral Springs, Florida, was advised by doctors at the end of December to quit after the condition returned, pps said in a press statement ahead of the World Cup series which starts in Hong Kong on Saturday.
